channel.title: Podio incidents — Vendor Status Watch

item.title: Podio is experiencing issues with workflow automation [resolved]
item.description:

No further impact has been observed and we are considering this issue to be resolved. If you are still experiencing any issues, please let us know via support at Help Center (https://support.sharefile.com/s/)
